editor.playConnect: Connect your SMK-37 to play. Sound comes from the SMK-37 audio output.
editor.playHelp: Click or touch the keys, or play A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P ;. Channels 1–3 play parts 1–3; drums normally use channel 10.
editor.playMock: Preview only: the mock device makes no sound.
editor.deviceDisplayHelp: Changes apply to the SMK-37 screen and save. Changes made while playing save after STOP.
editor.deviceFavHelp: Stars and the favorites filter sync with the SMK-37. Save computer-library sounds to a device user slot before starring them.
editor.deviceEmpty: No favorites yet. Choose All presets to add some.
editor.deviceUnsaved: Applied, but could not save on the device. Try again.
editor.notesHelp: Enter notes like C4 E4 G4 (up to 4, C4 = 60). Hits are DRUM lanes: KICK >SNARE HATCL (> = accent).
editor.nomidi: This browser cannot do it. Open the page in Chrome or Edge.
editor.nodevice: Felucca not found. Connect it by USB and press Connect again.
editor.confirmLoad: Load slot {n}? The sounds and sequences of all four tracks are replaced (no undo).
editor.confirmInit: Reset the sound to the engine defaults? The sequence stays (hold SAVE on the device to undo).
editor.smpHelp: Choose files or record an input. Drag waveform ends to trim; wheel to zoom. Up to 16 sounds and about 7 s per slot.
editor.confirmUpload: Write to USR{n}? Its current contents will be replaced.
editor.layout: (The firmware has a different parameter count; showing a plain list.)
editor.ctlHelp: Sliders: click, then fine-tune with the wheel or arrow keys (Shift: steps of 10); double-click resets.
editor.name: Name
editor.libEmpty: The library is empty. Add sounds with "Save current sound", by copying a factory preset or a device slot, or by importing a file.
editor.noLibDB: (this browser cannot store it: it is gone after a reload)
editor.dndHelp: You can also drag between the library and the slots.
editor.promptNameAuto: Name (12 ASCII characters; empty: the device names it)
editor.auditioned: Auditioning (the sound only, the sequence stays; hold SAVE on the device to undo):
editor.loadedUser: Sound loaded (the sequence stays; its pattern is on the device under SAVE > PHRASES; hold SAVE to undo):
editor.reloaded: The sound changed on the device: read again
editor.badEngine: This firmware has no such engine:
editor.smpNone: This firmware has no user sample slots.
editor.bankConnect: Connect the SMK-37 to see its user presets too.
editor.bankNone: This firmware has no user presets.
editor.drumNote: The drum track has no engine or presets. Level, pan and mute: Tracks; the kit: Settings > DRUMS; the pattern: Sequencer.
editor.drumHelp: Enter drums by GM name or number, like KICK SNARE CHH (up to 4).
editor.mixHelp: The four tracks of the device's MIXER page. The fader is the level. Pan is written to any track without changing the selection (firmware 0.8: by selecting it for a moment). REC shows a track armed for live recording on the device.
editor.projHelp: A project keeps the sounds and patterns of all four tracks, the song chain, the selected track and the global settings.
installer.intro: Connect the FM-1 by USB. (Works in Chrome or Edge.)
installer.warn: Do not unplug the USB cable while writing.
installer.editor: Play in your browser or edit your connected FM-1
installer.direct: Connect the USB cable directly to the computer. No probe or Transporter is needed.
installer.brick: If an install fails and the FM-1 no longer starts, recovering it needs a Transporter:
installer.beta:
This firmware is a release candidate. Validation on an FM-1 is pending.
The author accepts no responsibility if your FM-1 is damaged or misbehaves because of this custom firmware. Use it at your own risk.
installer.back: Get official FM-1 V15 from M-VAVE and select the unmodified FM-1.fwsc. The browser validates it locally; it is not sent to a server.
installer.nomidi: This browser cannot do it. Open the page in Chrome or Edge.
installer.stopped: Stopped. Replug the USB cable and press Install again.
installer.denied: MIDI (SysEx) access was not allowed. Allow MIDI in the site settings (address bar) and press Install again.
installer.notfound: FM-1 not found. Check the USB cable (a data cable), close other apps that use MIDI, and press Install again.
installer.model: The connected device is not an FM-1.
installer.lost: The USB connection was lost. Replug it and press Install again.
installer.noloader: The FM-1 in update mode was not found. Replug the USB cable and press Install again (it stays in update mode until it is finished).
installer.noreturn: The FM-1 did not come back. Power-cycle it.
installer.mismatch: Written, but the FM-1 reports another version:
installer.badpkg: The file to install is damaged. Reload the page.
installer.leave: Writing. Do not close the page.

site.play_a_sound_in_your_browser_or_con: Play a sound in your browser or connect your FM-1. A hands-on editor, expressive MIDI, and twelve looks to make it yours.
site.these_updates_are_available_now_in_: These updates are available now in the editor. No firmware update is needed for browser sound.

site.nine_felucca_engines_54_factory_pre: Thirteen Felucca engines, 69 factory presets, built-in samples, live sound controls, chords, sustain, and a separate browser volume.
site.a_full_width_display_follows_the_ac: A full-width display follows the actual browser audio output and matches your selected theme.
site.stage_red_matrix_vintage_dx_model_d: Stage Red, Matrix, vintage DX, Model D, Chocolate, Vaporwave, and more, with light/dark modes and a dedicated high-contrast theme. Wood, molded surfaces, screws, and display fonts give each its own character.
site.choose_knobs_or_sliders_per_sound_c: Choose knobs or sliders per Sound card, drag cards to rearrange them, and switch to full width from the menu.
site.a_keyboard_that_stays_within_reach: A keyboard that stays within reach.
site.play_with_your_mouse_touch_or_compu: Play with your mouse, touch, or computer keys. The docked keyboard starts at the FM-1's F3–G5 range, adds shaded extra keys on wide screens, and folds into a tray.
site.browser_mode_currently_plays_one_so: Browser mode currently plays one sound. Sequencing, track mixing, sample uploads, and projects are not connected to browser playback yet. Save sound edits with

site.vintage_dx_editor_theme_and_its_har: Vintage DX editor theme and its hardware-style controls
site.model_d_editor_theme_with_a_wooden_: Model D editor theme with a wooden cabinet and analog-style controls
site.vaporwave_editor_theme_with_colorfu: Vaporwave editor theme with colorful synth controls
site.light_high_contrast_editor_theme_wi: Light high-contrast editor theme with dark, clearly defined controls
site.actual_editor_screenshots_select_an: Choose a thumbnail to open Studio in that theme.
site.on_the_fm_1_felucca_salt_firmware_f: On the FM-1: Felucca [Salt] firmware features
site.included_in_0_9_salt13_building_on_: Included in 1.0-salt1rc1, building on the original Felucca firmware:
site.play_through_usb_or_trs_with_trs_en: Play through USB or TRS, with TRS enabled by default.
site.sustain_pedal_pitch_bend_with_adjus: Sustain pedal, pitch bend with adjustable MIDI bend sensitivity, mod wheel, and MIDI reset and all-notes-off handling.
site.select_internal_usb_or_trs_clock_wi: Select internal, USB, or TRS clock, with MIDI Start, Stop, and Continue. Includes keremimo's clock-sync contribution.
site.twenty_palettes_in_total_including_: 21 palettes, including light, dark, and high-contrast options.
site.select_regular_or_bold_text_with_di: Select regular or bold text, with distinct track colors and status colors for playback, recording, and MIDI activity.
site.star_factory_presets_and_saved_user: Star factory presets and saved user sounds, then browse all sounds or favorites only. Small favorites lists show each entry once; stars and the filter are saved.
site.choose_off_events_or_notes_the_bott: Choose Off, Events, or Notes. The bottom-right of the waveform shows the latest event or currently held notes and chords, including notes held by the sustain pedal.
site.device_display_controls_palette_fon: Device display controls palette, font, and monitor mode. Library
site.device_presets_manages_favorite_sta: Device presets manages favorite stars and filtering. Settings
site.install_felucca_salt_and_reconnect_: Install Felucca [Salt] and reconnect the editor to use the new web controls. Favorites bookmark sounds; save edited sounds to a user slot to keep your changes.

ui.audioNeed: Enable audio to play and edit a sound in your browser.
ui.audioOneSound: Browser audio · One sound · Built-in samples
ui.audioStopped: Browser audio stopped · Enable audio to resume
ui.audioPlayHelp: Playing in your browser · Sustain and polyphonic chords supported · No SMK-37 required
ui.audioStartHelp: Click Enable audio to play in your browser.
ui.noWebAudio: This browser does not support Web Audio.
ui.cookieSummary: We use browser storage for site features and your preferences. Optional Google Analytics cookies are on by default to help us understand how the site is used. Choose Essential only to turn analytics off.
ui.cookieDetails: We use browser storage for site features and preferences. Optional Google Analytics cookies are on by default to measure visits, theme choices, download clicks, and installation results. Essential only turns analytics off. We do not send MIDI notes, audio, or preset names. Every feature works with essential storage only. You can change your choice here anytime.
ui.dragHelp: Drag to rearrange. Arrow keys move one position; Home/End move first/last.
ui.wireDesc: FM-1 with eight rotary controls, a screen, twelve function buttons, octave buttons, and 27 touch keys.
ui.modeTipPlay: Play the {engine} built into the browser.
editor.fm6Help: Edit the whole patch of the FM6 engine (six operators). The device's knobs are macros on top of it. Import a SysEx file, pick a voice, edit it and send it to a track: it plays at once. A track has one patch: whatever you load becomes it (SLOT shows OWN).
editor.fm6Legend: R1..R4 / L1..L4: EG rates and levels; BP LD RD LC RC: keyboard level scaling; RS: rate scaling; AMS: LFO amplitude modulation; KVS: velocity; OL: output level; MODE: ratio / fixed; FC FF: coarse / fine frequency; DET: detune (7 = centre). ● = carrier.
editor.fm6Pick: Voices of the imported file (click to edit):
editor.fm6Factory: F1..F8 are the factory patches: pick B1..B27.
editor.backupHelp: Save the current music, A–D, sound banks, user samples and settings to this computer.
editor.backupOld: Complete backups need firmware with archive support.
editor.backupConfirm: Restore this complete backup? Current music, saved data and samples will be replaced. Keep USB connected.
editor.devicePending: Applied. Settings will save when playback stops.
editor.songHelp: Arrange patterns from saved slots and choose their repeats. The current sounds stay. Save a project above to keep the chain. Rows change at the end of track 1; the song stops at the end.
editor.songSaved: Chain changed. Save a project to keep it.
installer.stockGo: Back up and return to official V15
installer.stockBackup: Current music, saved music, sound banks, samples and settings are saved first. Older firmware needs a Felucca update for complete backups. To restore an archive later, reinstall Felucca and use the editor.
installer.stockRecovery: Resume an interrupted update: I already saved a complete backup to this computer
installer.stockConfirm: Has the complete backup file been saved to this computer? Continue to return to official V15. Official V15 cannot open Felucca music.
installer.stockNeedBackup: An update loader cannot export a backup. Only select resume if you already saved a complete backup.
installer.stockUnsupported: This Felucca does not support complete backups. Install the current Felucca first.
guide.title: Meet your new custom FM-1 controls...
guide.intro: Choose a group to highlight the controls and learn what they do.
guide.columns: Edit the four columns on the current page
guide.save: Save and load sounds or projects
guide.play: Start or stop all four tracks
guide.record: Arm the selected track for recording, on any page
guide.range: 27 touch keys play the selected track
guide.octave: Shift down or up one octave
guide.reset: Press both to reset the octave
guide.confirm: Confirm an action in dialogs and menus
guide.back: Go back in dialogs and menus

guide.song: Open SONG to chain patterns A–D

guide.pagesHint: Press a page button again to move to its next page.

editor.fm6Keep: To keep a voice, send it to a track, then save a user preset (SAVE) or a project on the device.
editor.fm6NoVoice: No 6-operator FM voices found (expects a 32-voice bank or single-voice SysEx)
editor.fm6NotSysex: Not a SysEx file (expects a 6-operator FM 32-voice bank or single-voice SysEx)
editor.fm6Is4op: These are 4-operator FM voices: FM6 reads 6-operator voices only
editor.fm6OtherBlocks: 6-operator file format, but no voices (performance or supplement data only)
editor.fm6NeedDevice: Connect the SMK-37 to edit 6-OP FM voices and send them to a track.
editor.fm6NoFw: This firmware has no 6-OP FM (FM6). Update to Felucca 1.0 or later to use it.
editor.smkLearnHelp: Map an incoming MIDI CC to a track parameter. Save a project on the SMK to keep the mapping.
ui.audioVersionMismatch: The browser sound engine and Studio are different versions. Reload this page to load the matching audio files.
editor.smkSampleSetup: No sample slots are active. On builds with sample storage, use NAVIGATE → SYSTEM → SAMPLE STORAGE on the SMK, then reconnect. Initialization replaces stock sample data; keep your stock backup.
